**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 242 **Price** 150 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L **Base Weapon** [Dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=358) --- The serrated blade of this _+1 striking [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)_ has a greenish tinge, and the hilt is sculpted to look like the head of a serpent about to strike. When you critically succeed at an attack roll with the serpent dagger, the target becomes sickened 1 unless it succeeds at a DC 19 Fortitude save. This is a poison effect. In addition, you can activate the dagger to poison a creature with a more potent poison. **Activate—Drip Poison** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You poison the creature you hit with dagger venom.
**Dagger Venom** ([poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) **Saving Throw** DC 21 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 4 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d8 poison damage and enfeebled 1
